name: Ancient World Boss: Leviathan of the First Flood
lore: A catastrophic primordial beast awakened when multiple Gate scars align beneath ancient waters. It is a campaign-scale threat, not a faction unit.
visualDescription: Colossal mythic sea serpent-dragon made of stormwater, basalt scales, drowned temple chains, moonlit eyes, and tidal crown horns.
mapBehavior: Campaign boss encounter that transforms terrain each phase.
